metadata.description: Lowercase workload token used in CAF-derived resource names.
Deployment environment token. prod is retained for compatibility with established CAF-named workloads.
CAF region token used in resource names.
Zero-padded CAF instance identifier.
Azure region for regional observability resources.
Accountable owner or team alias for the Owner tag.
Foundry product or workload value for the Project tag.
Allocation code for the CostCenter tag.
Lifecycle tag for package-created resources.
ISO 8601 expiry date for temporary or sandbox resources. Supply an empty string only for permanent resources.
Provisioning authority for the ManagedBy tag.
Private action-group recipient addresses. Keep real addresses in a private overlay.
Short display name in action-group notifications.
Azure-supported action-group location.
Monthly subscription budget in USD. This is an alert threshold, not a spending cap.
Subscription budget resource name. Existing deployments must supply their current budget name to preserve it.
First day of the monthly budget period in yyyy-MM-01 form.
Inclusive end of the budget period in ISO 8601 UTC form.
Actual-cost budget notifications. Object keys: low, medium, high. Values are percentages.
Whether forecast budget notifications are enabled.
Forecast budget notifications. Object keys: low, medium, high. Values are percentages.
Log Analytics SKU name selected by the consumer.
Azure Monitor Workspace public-network-access setting.
Log Analytics interactive retention in days.
Log Analytics daily quota safety value in GB.
Whether to create the native Azure Monitor dashboard with Grafana shell.
Whether to deploy the preview native Grafana dashboard-definition resource.
Dashboard-definition child-resource name. Azure Monitor dashboards require the literal value default.
Serialized source-controlled dashboard JSON. It must contain no credentials, private URLs, prompts, responses, or personal data.
Azure-supported location for Foundry alert rule resources.
Whether to deploy selected Activity Log alerts for Foundry deployment failures, Service Health, Resource Health, or high-risk resource changes.
Activity Log alert definitions. Each item contains name, description, enabled, scopes, and conditionAllOf.
Whether to deploy Azure Monitor metric alerts for existing Foundry resources. Enable only metrics supported by the target account or project.
Foundry metric alert definitions. Each item contains name and full metric-alert properties except actions.
Whether to deploy Foundry alert-processing rules for approved maintenance or response routing scenarios.
Alert-processing rule definitions. Each item contains name, location, and full properties.
Whether to deploy selected diagnostic categories to an existing Microsoft Foundry account.

Foundry diagnostic-setting configuration. Required keys when enabled: targetSubscriptionId, targetResourceGroupName, targetFoundryAccountName, name, logs, metrics, optional logAnalyticsDestinationType.
Whether to create workspace-based Application Insights for an approved Foundry application, API, or agent telemetry scenario.
Application Insights configuration. Required keys when enabled are documented in docs/implementation/foundry-observability.md.
Whether to create approved Application Insights availability tests. This requires Application Insights and a safe, non-destructive health endpoint.
Availability-test definitions. Each item contains name, kind, properties, and optional tags. No secret-bearing request data is allowed.
Whether to create scheduled query alerts against approved Foundry diagnostics or application telemetry.
Scheduled query alert definitions. Each item contains name and full alert properties.
